answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities: 200 slots are sold per epoch. Each applicant posts a sealed bid plus a 50-token deposit; the top 200 win and pay the lowest price. The kernel is the lock: deposits stay locked 20 epochs and burn on cheating. Making 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 tokens, while one honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards. Bids flow like a river. A plume of spam bids only raises the price against the spammer.
